_comment: Edit this file to update the rotating field-notes and the destination spotlight without touching the JavaScript. Changes go live on the next push/deploy.
fieldNotes: Understand the journey, then remove every point of friction.
Mobile-first — because travel happens in the dead zones.
Ship fast, then obsess over the details that feel effortless.
The compass in our mark is a promise: we help people find their way.
Every commit deploys to the edge — this site included.

spotlight.title: Maritimes Grand Loop
spotlight.fact: A 12-day loop through Newfoundland & Nova Scotia — ferries, fishing villages, and iceberg alley off the northern coast.

spotlight.title: Zürich Weekend
spotlight.fact: Three days from Copenhagen to Zürich — lake, old town, and the alps, with logistics tuned to the minute.

spotlight.title: Santa Fe June
spotlight.fact: Seven nights at 7,200 feet — adobe, galleries, cliff dwellings, and a dawn balloon ride over the high desert.
